name: dojo
description: Claude Code plugins: Kaizen (AI-assisted SDLC), Agent Skills (Addy Osmani's engineering workflows, the base Kaizen converges on), Motion Studio (motion design as code) and Slide Studio (presentation decks)

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: The engine around Addy Osmani's agent-skills, embedded: one plugin with its whole workflow under /kaizen: (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship, ideate, debug…), plus what it does not do — a quality gate that keeps a turn open while checks are red, agent-skills' review recorded by itself and required before any push, no secret committed, learnings brought back when a spec, a plan or a file they cover is touched, the PR followed to looks-ready (/kaizen:watch), approximated DORA metrics, friction and cost per feature (/kaizen:metrics). Stops at the merge-ready PR: no deployment

plugins.name: motion-studio
plugins.description: Motion design as code: HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas animations rendered frame by frame to MP4/WebM/GIF via Playwright + ffmpeg, with synced sound, voice-over and subtitles

plugins.name: slide-studio
plugins.description: Presentation decks as one HTML file: themed template with 19 layouts (ink, paper, kaizen), browser presenter with notes and steps, slide-by-slide layout check, PDF/PNG export
